command.name: security key-manager external aws update-credentials
command.description: This command allows the user to update the secret access key which is used by the Amazon Web Service Key Management Service (AWSKMS) configured for the given Vserver. The secret access key is initially set by running the security key-manager external aws enable command. This command will fail if AWSKMS has not been enabled for the Vserver.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Vserver for which the AWSKMS secret access key will be updated.

parameter.name: access-key-id
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the new access key id of the updated credentials.

parameter.name: skip-verify
parameter.description: Set this parameter to true to skip verification of the updated credentials.

example.p: The following example updates the AWSKMS secret access key for Vserver v1.
example.screen:
cluster-1::> security key-manager external aws update-credentials -vserver v1
Enter the new secret access key: Press <Enter> when done
